title: Daily Public Authority Generation Contract
purpose: Define the source-backed daily public-authority lanes, validated candidate feeds, and review-gated destination promotion contract.
coreRule: Only complete, non-empty, schema-valid, application-validated public-source output may become a sanitized promotion candidate. Provider HTTP success alone is never usable output.

lanes.scope: Notary, apostille, authentication, public-law, and source-quality structured knowledge.
Reusable public-safe technical, API, cloud, developer-tool, and platform source trails.

scheduler.pumpBoundary: The pump refreshes health, latest indexes, and digests without provider calls. It also refuses provider execution for legacy pump queue envelopes.
scheduler.manualRegressionBoundary: Regression batches are manual or explicitly queued diagnostics. They are not the daily authority-generation scheduler.

openAiContract.failClosedBoundary: Authority calls unconditionally require OpenAI__PublicSourceApiKey; generic OpenAI__ApiKey is never selected.

reasoningAndOutput.repairBoundary: Retry only a bounded unusable or transient attempt; never publish either raw attempt.

selectionState.candidateId: SHA-256 of destination, normalized topic, summary, and sorted source URLs
selectionState.duplicateCandidateBehavior: Atomic create-if-absent; duplicate generation is a no-op.
selectionState.incrementalRule: Skip targets with a fresh successful validated output and skip a second daily selection for the same batch.

promotion.repositoryPolicyPrerequisite: The destination repository Actions setting can_approve_pull_request_reviews must permit GITHUB_TOKEN pull-request creation. The workflow must preflight and fail closed when it is false; this repair does not change that protected setting.
promotion.promotedCandidateFeedBehavior: Exclude destination and candidate ID after a validated draft-PR promotion receipt.
promotion.publicationBoundary: Only a trusted destination default-branch workflow acknowledges a same-repository authority PR after merge to main; it does not execute PR code.
promotion.lastPromotionSource: Validated draft-PR acknowledgement containing the exact destination candidate and pull-request URL.
promotion.lastPublicationSource: Validated merged-PR acknowledgement matching the existing promotion receipt.

retention.compactionRule: Preserve latest indexes, daily selection records, promotion candidates, publication acknowledgements, provider evidence, and actionable failures before any future reviewed compaction implementation.

allowed: reviewable destination candidates and pull requests
excluded: private prompts or raw provider responses
secrets, keys, tokens, or private endpoints
